title: Agentic Workspace Repo Config
description: Current human configuration authoring, version 2. Version 1 sources are read separately; never use former syntax for new settings.

execution_posture.description: Provider-neutral execution posture keyed by current repository semantic route. Requirements narrow eligibility; preferences inform comparison only.

additionalProperties.description: Posture for one exact current semantic route, without a built-in task taxonomy.

independent_context.description: Require a current work-relative independent context; a static target tag cannot establish independence.

required_execution_guarantees.description: Hard provider-neutral execution requirements applied before comparison.

preferred_execution_guarantees.description: Soft comparison preferences among already eligible alternatives.

independent.description: Durable admission of independently linked native owners. Installation alone grants no effects, claims, reads or restrictions. Operational state remains with the owner.

additionalProperties.description: Exact repository grant for one separately linked native owner.

contract_revision.description: Digest of the admitted capability and configuration descriptor.

effects.description: Effect identifiers granted only within this owner domain.

claims.description: Exclusive claim identifiers separately granted to this owner.

restrictions.description: Exact task, effect or claim scopes this owner may restrict.

reads.description: Bounded exact repository-relative sources the owner may observe.

scope.description: Repository path prefixes that select this owner for current changed work.

settings.description: Durable owner settings validated against its declared configuration schema.

enabled.description: Repo-owned enabled Agentic Workspace modules. Use [] for routing/config-only installs.

modules.description: Authoritative module enablement for this repository.

workspace.description: Repo-owned workspace policy for startup adapter shape, output posture, and advanced feature opt-ins. Module selection lives in top-level modules.enabled.

enabled.description: Effective Agentic Workspace operation switch. Defaults to true; when false, ordinary AW workflow commands return a disabled-state packet while diagnostic and recovery commands remain available. Machine-local config.local.toml may override this value.

agent_instructions_file.description: Repo startup adapter text file agents should read first.

workflow_artifact_profile.description: Shape of generated workflow and handoff artifacts.

improvement_latitude.description: How much repo-directed improvement initiative Agentic Workspace may surface by default.

cli_invoke.description: Repo-owned command prefix agents should use to invoke Agentic Workspace in this repository, such as a source-checkout or dev-dependency invocation. User-specific installs can still override this with .agentic-workspace/config.local.toml.

update.description: Module update-source policy for installed Agentic Workspace modules.

modules.description: Per-module update-source overrides. Omitted modules use product defaults.

planning.description: Update-source policy for the planning module.

memory.description: Update-source policy for the memory module.

workflow_obligations.description: Specialized compatibility-only stage-bound workflow obligations. Ordinary repo guidance belongs in .agentic-workspace/instructions/*.md.

^.+$.description: +$ referenced contract shape used by this contract.

system_intent.description: Repo-owned sources for durable product or project intent.

sources.description: Ordered candidate files that describe durable repo intent.

items.description: One entry in the sources list.

preferred_source.description: Preferred intent source, usually one of system_intent.sources.

assurance.description: Default trust and proof posture for work when active planning does not override it.

default_level.description: Baseline assurance level for proof and trust guidance.

agent_may_escalate.description: Whether agents may raise assurance level when risk or scope warrants it.

agent_may_deescalate.description: Whether agents may lower assurance level below the configured default.

decision_record_target.description: Path for durable decision records when work requires one; explicit config wins, but conventional ADR directories may be discovered when this is unset.

decision_record_fallback.description: Independent Memory source-owner admission of a bounded decision archive snapshot and its semantic provenance; never a public request argument.

archive.description: Exact repository-relative Memory source archive admitted by its host owner.

admitted_revision.description: Immutable Git commit explicitly admitting this Memory snapshot and semantic provenance.

decision_delegations.description: Standing repository policy delegating future semantic decisions to the acting agent only for an exact durable owner and path set. Each decision separately binds current material, work, dependencies and destination. Shared policy only; no actor identity, execution/proof/claim authority or local override is granted.

owner.description: Existing durable decision owner receiving the delegated decision.

scope.description: Exact set of path:repository-relative-file scopes. No wildcard, subset, task-class or prose matching.

instruction_revision.description: Trusted repository-owner admission of binding checks/protect in the exact scoped Markdown snapshot. Never inferred from HEAD, tracking, or instruction contents.

decision_record_revision.description: Trusted source-owner admission of this exact archive Git commit, including semantic provenance. Never infer from HEAD, tracking or record actor strings.

payload.description: Repo-owned installed payload target policy. Use this when the checked-in payload must be kept aligned with a release or source-checkout capability target independent of the CLI install location.

target_release.description: Desired checked-in Agentic Workspace payload release. Use source-current for source-checkout dogfooding.

minimum_capabilities.description: Payload-owned install-target capabilities that must be present in checked-in payload provenance before the target is satisfied. The same capability cannot also appear in cli_compatibility.required_capabilities.

policy.description: How strongly startup should gate work when the installed payload does not satisfy the repo-declared target.

dogfood_latest.description: For the Agentic Workspace source repo, require the checked-in payload to track the latest source-checkout payload before ordinary work.

cli_compatibility.description: Expected CLI identity and posture for commands executed in this repo.

enforcement.description: How strictly CLI compatibility expectations should be enforced.

minimum_version.description: Minimum accepted Agentic Workspace CLI version.

exact_version.description: Exact accepted Agentic Workspace CLI version when a repo must pin execution.

source_classes.description: Allowed source classes for the invoked CLI executable.

items.description: One entry in the source classes list.

target_relations.description: Allowed relation between the invoked CLI executable and the target repo.

items.description: One entry in the target relations list.

command.description: Expected CLI command string when the repo wants compatibility checks to match a specific invocation.

contract_schema.description: Durable installed-state contract schema expected by this repository.

required_capabilities.description: Reader/runtime compatibility capabilities required from the configured Agentic Workspace CLI. Install-target capabilities belong only in payload.minimum_capabilities and cannot be duplicated here.

required_resources.description: Package resources required from the configured Agentic Workspace runtime, expressed as package:relative/path.

minimum_reader_epoch.description: Minimum pre-state compatibility reader epoch required before this repository's managed state may be interpreted.

required_reader_capabilities.description: Root-reader capabilities required before generated handlers or managed repository state may be loaded.

resolution_policy.description: Required dependency-resolution posture for the configured invocation.

module_update_policy.description: Update source metadata for a managed module.

source_type.description: Where upgrade or install should resolve the module payload from.

source_ref.description: Git URL/ref or local path, depending on source_type.

source_label.description: Human-readable label for status and report output.

recommended_upgrade_after_days.description: Age threshold after which status or doctor may suggest checking for updates.

workflow_obligation.description: Specialized compatibility obligation surfaced only for a concrete stage-bound lifecycle consumer; not a generic repo-guidance format.

stage.description: Workflow stage where this obligation matters.

force.description: How strongly a matched obligation affects the next action or closeout gate.

scope_tags.description: Tags used to match the obligation to touched work scopes.

items.description: One entry in the scope tags list.

commands.description: Commands to run or consider at the matching workflow stage.

items.description: One entry in the commands list.

review_hint.description: Short reminder to surface during review or closeout.
